It's been a month since the last update and all I can say is: Time sure flies by fast!

New features

HideSubmissions

This module has been requested fairly often, and I just had to implement it. It comes with some options. Its basic purpose is storing submissions' IDs in an array and removing these submissions when it finds them.

You can mark a submission as hidden by pressing "b" or clicking the "hide" link added after "save". Another possibility is to choose to hide a post after upvoting and/or downvoting it. In all cases, you can choose to remove it from the page right after marking it as hidden.

SingleClickOpener

Adds '[l+c]' link to submissions, click it to open at the same time the link and the comment pages. Same as pressing "b".

ArchiveSubmission

This module adds yet another option to a submission block: "archive". Click it to open the linked page in "archive.is". If you don't want to use archive.is, tell me which other archive websites are available.

ThemeSwitcher

Simply allows switching between the light and dark themes without reloading the page. You may notice some issue with certain AVE's elements but nothing critical.
